summary_en: 769,500 shares issued to acquire 100% of JINEN K.K. (10,000 shares) via simplified stock exchange. Effective 2026-06-30. No shareholder objections filed during opposition notice period. Rationale: integration of community design/operation expertise with OKWAVE Q&A and GRATICA contribution data to advance co-creative community services and SaaS expansion.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Complete Subsidiary Status of JINEN Corporation via Simplified Stock Exchange
translation_en_brief:
On 2026-06-30, OKWave completed acquisition of JINEN Corporation via simplified stock exchange. OKWave issued 769,500 new shares to acquire all 10,000 outstanding shares of JINEN (100% ownership). The board resolutions and stock exchange contract were executed on 2026-05-14, with JINEN shareholders approving the merger at an extraordinary general meeting on the same date. OKWave, as parent company, followed the simplified stock exchange procedure under the Companies Act Article 796(2), publishing notice of the exchange from 2026-05-14 with no shareholder objections received.

JINEN, established 2023-06-30, provides community-formation consulting, community manager training, and DX support for community development. The acquisition enables OKWave to integrate JINEN's community design and operations expertise with OKWave's Q&A database and GRATICA's contribution-tracking data to accelerate growth in co-creative community services. Management states the group will pursue three strategic priorities post-integration: unified co-creative community support services, SaaS subscription-revenue model establishment, and competitive differentiation via AI and data analytics. Financial impact to current-period consolidated results is under review and will be disclosed separately if material.
